cohort_rankings.note: No matched competitor captures exist for these stage-04 implementation files. No provider rank, Ky gap or competitor-win claim is made. Earlier rounds scored different (empty-state, original) KyCalendar images; their numbers are not a baseline for improvement.

drift.note: Not applicable: these are new implementation captures, not re-scores of earlier images. Earlier reranked grid 7.3 / editor 7.9 described different originals.

kycalendar.event-editor: N/A at final source. No stage-04 capture of the New event / edit dialog. Stage-03 new-event captures (04:57Z) predate later theme.css/calendar.css edits and still show the rejected two-panel shell behind the dialog; not scored. The dialog appears only as cropped date fields in the focus composite.
kycalendar.calendar-list desktop: N/A in the scored set: desktop List appears only in draft-resize mobile-*-2-crossed frames (evidence-only).
kycalendar.week/day on phone: N/A: phone landing view is List; phone week appears only behind the disclosure in draft-resize desktop-*-2-crossed frames (evidence-only).
kycalendar.named themes: N/A: no stage-04 named-theme capture. Gate run records Nord select persisting under ky_theme; stage-02 Nord captures predate stage 04.
kycalendar.admin, settings page, devices, auth: not in the stage-04 batch; not rescored here

keyboard.evidence: Recorded by implementer (screenshots/kycalendar-gates.json, browser/resize.spec.mjs, 24 Chromium tests) on source 62da0101…: Tab walk nav -> list/disclosure -> theme -> Sign out -> New event -> toolbar; dialog initial focus on Title; Escape closes and focus returns to New event; Escape closes the phone disclosure to its summary. Reviewer read the JSON: dialog_focus_left_dialog lists one stop whose text is the whole app ('KyCalendarCalendarPhones…'), consistent with the Chromium browser-chrome wrap on <body>, after which focus re-enters at kc-title. Limits: drag-and-drop has no keyboard path (pre-existing); subscribe/rename form submission by keyboard not separately recorded.

focus.evidence: Recorded: tab_stops_without_ring and dialog_stops_without_ring empty in all four runs; date_focus visible in all. Reviewer inspected kycalendar-04-after-focus-date-fields.png: 2px accent ring at offset on the field root in both themes; picker-icon focus shows Chromium's native black/white box, accepted per the design contract. Accent ring also visible on the focused subscription Name field in draft-resize frames.

contrast.evidence: Recorded computed-style checks pass for 19-22 pairs per run (min 3.36:1 button border). Not covered: out-of-month day numbers in Month view. Reviewer screenshot-pixel estimate (darkest glyph pixel vs cell): ~1.35:1 Busnes Light, ~1.57:1 Busnes Dark (month-desktop crops at 380,192-404,210 and 390,632-404,650). Cause: FullCalendar's bundled `.fc-day-other .fc-daygrid-day-top{opacity:.3}` stacks with web/src/styles/calendar.css:90 `opacity:.7` (effective ~0.21). Pixel estimate is a proxy; confirm with computed style after the fix. Named palettes unmeasured.

states.evidence: No empty, loading or error captures for calendar views, calendar edit or subscribe forms.

responsive.evidence: Recorded overflow_px 0 for all 32 captures and 4 gate runs; mobile_nav scrolls (overflow-x auto) with all three items reachable; targets >=40px except 16px checkboxes with 40px labels. Reviewer note (quality, not gate): phone nav clips 'Phones & a' mid-word with no scroll cue, and phone Month labels are illegible.
